title: Action de Galois sur Teichmüller : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context (pp. 96-99 of the notes): Grothendieck is listing necessary conditions on an outer automorphism Θ of a profinite fundamental groupoid π̂_1(X, I), with I ⊂ X(Q̄) a set of base points, for Θ to come from an element u ∈ Γ = Gal(Q̄/Q). The previous page ends by saying he had forgotten 'the most important of all' the conditions. This page names it: compatibility with the 'structures à bout', the structure at the ends of the curve.

In modern terms, for a curve X = X̄ − S, each puncture s has a punctured formal disc (a 'rondelle épointée'). That disc gives a tangential base point and a conjugacy class of inertia subgroups Ẑ(1) → π̂_1. The condition is that Θ sends each inertia generator (loop γ_s) to a conjugate of γ_s^{χ(u)}, where χ is the cyclotomic character. Equivalently, Θ must be compatible with the maps from the fundamental groupoids of the punctured discs into π̂_1(X).

He makes three further points:
- For X of higher dimension one would need a general 'structure à l'infini' of fundamental groupoids.
- In the groupoid language this condition is 'particularly natural and elegant'. It has the same shape as the earlier compatibility with morphisms of sections (his (39), condition of rational points/sections). The only change is that sections over points are replaced by sections over punctured local models or 'rondelles'. He promises to return to this viewpoint.
- Remark: the conditions a), b) stated so far cannot be expressed, in more or less direct terms, as conditions on the 'parameters' that represent u. Examples of such parameters are f_σ(u), or the parameters α, β, ξ, η from his earlier study of the action on loops of Π_{0,3} (Th. 3?). The page breaks off, and the next page goes on to hope for interesting conjectures on profinite groups via M_{0,4}, M_{0,5} and the Teichmüller groups.

The problem served is a characterisation of the image of Γ in Out(π̂_1) (the GT programme), using groupoids with tangential base points.
errors: No mathematical error, but nothing is proved: the compatibility condition is only announced and its precise formulation is deferred ('je vais revenir sur ce point de vue plus bas').

The claim that conditions a) and b) are 'inexpressible' directly on parameters such as f_σ was in a sense overtaken. Drinfeld (1990) and Ihara gave explicit equations on (λ, f) coming from M_{0,4} and M_{0,5}. These equations are necessary conditions, though, not the full set of a), b) (stability under all étale covers), so Grothendieck's remark stays essentially correct for condition b).

ideas.what: The decisive necessary condition for an outer automorphism of π̂_1 of a punctured curve to come from Galois: compatibility with the structure at the punctures (inertia/'lacets' mapped to conjugates of χ(u)-powers).
ideas.modern_name: Inertia/branch-cycle condition; cyclotomic-character compatibility on inertia; defining condition of Out^♯ / 'inertia-preserving' automorphisms in GT and anabelian geometry
ideas.usually_credited_to: Belyi, Ihara, Drinfeld; also classical branch-cycle arguments (Fried)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (1984), §§2-3: discussion of the Teichmüller tower and of the action of Gal(Q̄/Q) on π̂_{0,3}

ideas.what: Formulating this condition as compatibility of Θ with morphisms from groupoids of punctured local models ('rondelles épointées') into the global groupoid, analogous to compatibility with sections at points.
ideas.modern_name: Tangential base points (Deligne 1989); fundamental groupoids with tangential base points; Galois action on path torsors from tangential points
ideas.usually_credited_to: Deligne (Le groupe fondamental de la droite projective moins trois points, 1989); Ihara; Nakamura
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme: fundamental groupoids based at sets of base points, and use of 'points base tangentiels'

ideas.what: Need, in higher dimension, of a 'structure à l'infini' of fundamental groupoids (generalising ends/punctures of curves).
ideas.modern_name: Profinite homotopy type at infinity / boundary-tangential base points on normal-crossing compactifications (log geometry, Kato-Nakayama spaces); Nakamura's tangential base points on M_{g,n}
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme alludes to the 'structure at infinity' of the Teichmüller tower (boundary strata of M̄_{g,n}); no general formulation

ideas.what: Remark that the Galois-origin conditions cannot be translated directly into conditions on parameters f_σ(u) (or α, β, ξ, η) attached to u.
ideas.modern_name: Parametrisation σ ↦ (χ(σ), f_σ) of Ihara and Drinfeld; defining relations of ĜT

missed.claim: Grothendieck wants a unified formalism in which all Galois-origin conditions (rational sections, and inertia via punctured local discs) are a single kind of condition: compatibility with morphisms of groupoids from 'local models', pointed or punctured. He also wants a general 'structure à l'infini' for groupoids of higher-dimensional varieties. Modern work (tangential base points, Nakamura's boundary conditions for M_{g,n}) covers special cases. A general formalism of this kind, treating section conditions and cusp/inertia conditions uniformly, does not seem to have been written down as such.
missed.quote: on sent bien qu'il faut introduire, dans le cas général, une "structure à l'infini" des groupoïdes fondamentaux ... une condition de la nature d'une compatibilité à des morphismes de sections (cf (39)) mais en prenant ici ... des "rondelles" épointées
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This links the section conjecture (sections ↔ rational points) with cuspidal/tangential sections and inertia conditions. That link is studied in work on cuspidal sections and packets (Esnault-Wittenberg, Stix), but a uniform 'local model' groupoid formulation could clarify it. Novelty is modest.

deep.surprise_reason: The page states the inertia-compatibility condition and a tangential-base-point viewpoint. Both are in the Esquisse and in later standard GT and anabelian literature. The remark on 'structure à l'infini' in higher dimension, and the parallel with section conditions, are suggestive but only sketched.
transcription_corrections: 'ou "modèles" épointés' should most likely read 'ou "rondelles" épointées' (punctured small discs).
'des sections : locales de Th 3' is more plausibly 'des lacets : lacets de Π_{0,3}' (Π03 written in Grothendieck's hand); uncertain.
'f_σ(u)' may be written f_c(u) in the image; it denotes the parameter attached to u ∈ Γ.
'il est clair d'emblée qu'elles sont incomplètes (c.à.d. inexprimables)': the first word is uncertain and may itself be a form of 'inexprimables'.
'dans mon étude avec disques[?]': the word after 'étude' is illegible, possibly 'avec dessins'.
'j'aimerais une condition' is uncertain; it may read 'j'énonce une condition'.
